shortDescription: Manage interface-specific IPv6 Router Advertisement configurations on SONiC

options.name: config
options.description: Specifies interface-specific IPv6 Router Advertisement configurations.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the configuration after module completion. C(merged) - Merges provided interface-specific IPv6 router advertisement configuration with on-device configuration. C(replaced) - Replaces on-device IPv6 router advertisement configuration of the specified interfaces with provided configuration. C(overridden) - Overrides all on-device interface-specific IPv6 router advertisement configurations with the provided configuration. C(deleted) - Deletes on-device interface-specific IPv6 router ad
